Your desktop, with a buddy on it.

Say hi to Shika

The name is printed on the belt, just like in the app. Click the pup to pet it. Tap anywhere on a phone and it runs over.
What it does

Four small jobs, done by a buddy.

Talk, and it types.

Hold Right Ctrl, speak, let go. The text lands at your cursor in whatever app you are using. No account and no internet needed after the first model download.

Your words will appear here.
Press and hold the button. Use Space or Enter on a keyboard.

Say a command.

Hold Right Alt (Right Option on a Mac) and say what you want.

open firefoxclose tablock screenvolume upsearch DV360 line item setupbe a pandacall yourself Momo

Reminders that bark.

Say "remind me at 5 to call Rahul". At 5 the buddy runs to the middle of your screen and barks. Tap it to mark the reminder done, double-tap to snooze 10 minutes.

Fix text by voice.

Select text in any app, hold the command key and say "fix grammar" or "make it shorter". A small model running on your own machine rewrites it and pastes it back. Ctrl+Z undoes it. This part is optional and needs Ollama.

Shika AI

AI that runs on your own computer.

Shika AI uses two small models. Both run locally, so your voice and your text are not sent to any company's server. You can swap either one for a model you like better.

Speech model

Included

Turns your voice into text. It uses faster-whisper with the small.en model. The installer downloads it, about 500 MB, and it runs on your CPU.

Language model

Asked at install

Cleans up what you said and edits selected text. It uses Ollama with qwen2.5:1.5b, about 1 GB. The installer asks if you want it, and the default answer is yes.

Your choice of model

One line to change

Use a bigger, smaller or multilingual model. Change one name in the program file and restart. The setup guide shows each step.

Change the model

What Shika AI does with your words

  • Fixes grammar, spelling, punctuation and capital letters.
  • Removes filler words such as "um" and "you know".
  • Follows your self-corrections. "At 4, no wait, 5" becomes "5".
  • Turns spoken punctuation like "comma" and "new line" into the real thing.
  • Puts a spoken list on separate lines.
  • Keeps your language. Hinglish stays Hinglish.

A typical result

You say

um so remind me at 4 no wait 5 to call Rahul comma and send the invoice

Shika AI types

Remind me at 5 to call Rahul, and send the invoice.

Results depend on the model you pick. This is an example, not a promise for every sentence.

No language model? It still works.

Dictation, commands, reminders and widgets do not need it. Without it, Shika uses quick rule based cleanup. Voice edits like "make it shorter" and "fix grammar" do need the language model.

# change these two lines in shika.py, then restart
WHISPER_MODEL = "small.en"      # speech to text
OLLAMA_MODEL  = "qwen2.5:1.5b"  # text cleanup and edits
How it works

From your voice to typed text in four steps.

  1. Hold the key. Hold Right Ctrl to dictate, or Right Alt (Right Option on a Mac) for a command.
  2. Speak. The buddy listens through your microphone. Nothing is recorded to a file.
  3. Your computer transcribes. The speech model turns the audio into text without using the internet.
  4. The text appears. If the language model is on, it tidies the text first. Then it is typed where your cursor is, in any app.

Install

Three commands, then say hi.

You need Python 3.10 or newer on Mac and Windows. The first run downloads a speech model of about 500 MB. The installer then asks if you want Shika AI, the language model, which is about 1 GB more. Add --no-ai to skip the question.

git clone https://github.com/iam-knr/desktop-buddy.git
cd desktop-buddy
bash install.sh

Log out and back in once so push-to-talk can read your keyboard.

git clone https://github.com/iam-knr/desktop-buddy.git
cd desktop-buddy
bash install-mac.sh

macOS asks for Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility. The guide shows where.

git clone https://github.com/iam-knr/desktop-buddy.git
cd desktop-buddy
.\install-windows.bat

No git? Download the ZIP from GitHub and double-click install-windows.bat.

Questions

Before you install it.

What is Shika AI?

Shika AI is a free, open source desktop companion and offline voice assistant for Linux, macOS and Windows. A small pet companion lives on your screen. You hold a key, speak, and your words are typed into the app you are using. It also keeps reminders, notes and a focus timer.

Is Shika AI the same as Desktop Buddy?

Yes. Desktop Buddy is the earlier name of the same project. The pup that walks on your screen is called Shika by default, and you can rename it.

Do I get the AI when I download it?

You always get the speech model, which turns your voice into text. The installer downloads it, about 500 MB. The language model that tidies your text is asked about during install, and the default answer is yes. It is about 1 GB. You can skip it with the no-ai option and add it later.

Is my voice sent anywhere?

No. Speech recognition and the language model both run on your computer. The only downloads are the model files, once.

Does it work without internet?

Yes, after the first install and model download. Dictation, commands, reminders and widgets all work offline.

How do I change the AI model?

Open the program file, find OLLAMA_MODEL for the language model or WHISPER_MODEL for the speech model, change the name, and restart. The setup guide has the exact steps, a list of good models and what each one costs in size and speed.

Which model is best for a slow computer?

Keep the defaults, or use base.en for speech and a 1B language model. A bigger model is smarter but slower on a CPU. If the language model is too slow, Shika gives up after a few seconds and uses basic cleanup instead.

Which languages does it understand?

English by default. You can switch to a multilingual speech model and set the language, or leave it on auto. Hindi and Hinglish text is kept as you speak it. Languages other than English have had much less testing.

Does it need a graphics card?

No. Both models run on the CPU. A graphics card is not needed.

Is it free?

Yes. It is open source under the MIT license. You can read the code, change it and share it.

Can I add my own character?

Yes. Characters are plain entries in one list in the program file. Copy one and change the colors, ears, tail and face.
